papers.headline: Constraints on Primordial Oscillatory Features from the Power Spectrum and Bispectrum of Redshift-Space Galaxy Clustering in DESI DR1
papers.summary: We constrain oscillatory features in the primordial power spectrum using the public DESI DR1 galaxy and quasar clustering data.
papers.title: Constraints on Primordial Oscillatory Features from the Power Spectrum and Bispectrum of Redshift-Space Galaxy Clustering in DESI DR1

papers.headline: Widespread steep X-ray spectra of luminous z≃5.85-7.5 quasars and their implications for future X-ray surveys
papers.summary: Luminous quasars (QSOs) at the Epoch of Reionization (EoR, z≳6) host billion-solar-mass black holes assembled within the first Gyr of cosmic time.
papers.title: Widespread steep X-ray spectra of luminous z≃5.85-7.5 quasars and their implications for future X-ray surveys

papers.headline: BOLT: Imaging Lightning and Terrestrial Gamma-ray Flashes at the Pierre Auger Observatory
papers.summary: Lightning-related phenomena are known to interact with and influence all detector systems of the Pierre Auger Observatory.
papers.title: BOLT: Imaging Lightning and Terrestrial Gamma-ray Flashes at the Pierre Auger Observatory
papers.authors: E. d. Boone, f. t. P. A. Collaboration
